description: Oak Ridge National Laboratory deposits 129 representative building energy archetypes and 120 area multipliers for Clark County, Nevada. Zenodo lists a public model ZIP and CSV under CC BY 4.0. The provider says AutoBEM condensed a larger inventory of 589,586 residential and commercial buildings into archetypes that represent conditioned floor area within the county. These EnergyPlus-style archetypes could replace individually simulating every building in city electricity-demand or heat-exposure scenarios. A related catalogue record covers Model America’s national building-level archive, not this Clark County aggregation. The separate Clark County full-building deposit is a different resource and should not be mistaken for the 129 archetypes. A limitation is that the landing page says the multipliers and models may be updated. The weights are model-derived, not evidence of audited floor areas or actual energy use. Neither the ZIP nor CSV was downloaded, so the 120 weights and 129 model files were not reconciled or run.
